office_does: The District Court 2 judge, based in Forks, hears misdemeanor criminal cases and small-claims civil matters arising on Clallam County's West End; elected by District Court 2 voters to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Bruce Hanify, appointed in 2021 and elected unopposed in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: District Court 2 judge since January 2021; previously a deputy prosecutor for 15 years and a criminal defense attorney for 17. A Forks High School graduate and the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed District Court 2 judge in 2021; elected unopposed in 2022 [S3][S4]
Deputy prosecutor for 15 years, then criminal defense attorney for 17 years [S1][S2]
Names mental health and addiction cases as the court's main challenge [S5]
